data.name: Bisht
data.gender_notes: Bisht is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Vishat', meaning 'to spread'. Bisht is a revered name for boys in Hindu tradition, symbolizing the divine presence of the sacred fire god Agni. The name encapsulates bravery, wisdom, and the power to ignite transformation. The name Bisht carries the meaning “Lord of Sacred Fire” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bisht usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of sacred fire and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Bisht is a name that evokes a sense of spiritual connection and divinity. It is a name that is often given to children who are believed to be blessed by the gods, and who are expected to live a life of spiritual growth and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Bisht belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of Sacred Fire.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Bisht total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

The meaning of the name serves as a constant reminder to be brave, wise, and radiant, and to embody the qualities of the powerful fire god Agni.
